step_verifier_cases.instruction: Explain the difference between mutable and immutable objects in Python with examples.
step_verifier_cases.result: In Python, mutable objects (such as lists, dictionaries, and sets) can have their state or contents modified in-place after creation without changing their object identity. Immutable objects (such as integers, floats, strings, and tuples) cannot be altered once created; any operation that modifies an immutable value constructs a new object.
